identity_marker: silver TENS 7000 unit with gray control buttons, two coiled lead wires, and four square black electrode pads
continuity_anchors: set against a flat wooden table and a human subject with an exposed lower back under bright, even indoor lighting
video_goal: Demonstrate the proper setup, pad placement, and activation of a TENS 7000 unit for lower back pain relief.
single_prompt: A top-down view shows hands placing a silver TENS 7000 unit with gray control buttons, two coiled lead wires, and four square black electrode pads onto a flat wooden table. The camera moves to a close-up as hands push the two plastic plugs of the lead wires firmly into the two circular ports located at the top edge of the unit. Fingers then push the red and black metal pins at the ends of the lead wires into the short wire connectors attached to each of the four electrode pads. Shifting to a first-person view, hands peel the clear plastic backing off the black, sticky side of the first square electrode pad. The camera transitions to a medium shot as a hand presses the first sticky pad onto the bare skin of the exposed lower back, positioning it exactly two inches to the left of the spine. The hand then presses the second pad onto the skin, two inches to the right of the spine, directly parallel to the first pad. Next, the hand presses the third and fourth pads onto the lower back, positioning them two inches below the first two pads to form a square pattern around the lumbar region. The camera moves to a close-up as fingers flip open the front plastic cover of the TENS 7000 unit to reveal the gray control buttons and the LCD screen. Thumb and index finger twist the top left dial clockwise until a physical click occurs and the LCD screen illuminates with black text. A finger presses the 'Mode' button below the screen, causing the text on the LCD display to cycle until the word 'Normal' appears. Fingers slowly twist both top dials clockwise, stopping when the LCD screen displays the number '3' to indicate the rising intensity level. Finally, transitioning to an over-the-shoulder view, the person slides the metal clip located on the back of the TENS 7000 unit securely onto the waistband of their pants.
